id: title:fivestarspicy:stop tailwind s size utility collapsing the combobox popup

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop UI accessibility and compatibility: P1.F1.H1 changes CSS class names to avoid a Tailwind utility collision, potentially resolving a rendering or accessibility issue in the desktop application's combobox component.
review.reason: The observed change P1.F1.H1 is a localized CSS and TypeScript modification to the desktop UI combobox component. It changes class names to avoid a Tailwind utility collision, which could prevent unintended styling or layout issues. This is a narrow, bounded maintenance and compatibility improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the Tailwind collision caused a production issue or visual regression, which is not independently verified in the provided observations. No tests or broader systemic changes are cited.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a CSS and TypeScript change to the desktop UI combobox component. No score assigned. No tier assigned.
